subtasks.instructions: Analyze the DL and AA carrier files for January and February 2025. For each carrier, group flights by undirected airport-pair route: sort the two airport codes alphabetically and join with '-'. (a) Find the route with the greatest number of scheduled flight records, counting cancelled records. (b) Among routes with at least 20 completed flights (cancelled=false; actual_dep should be present), calculate departure delay as actual_dep minus sched_dep in minutes, handling delayed departures after midnight by treating a time difference crossing midnight as positive elapsed minutes. A flight is delayed only when delay > 15 minutes. Find the route with the highest delayed/completed rate. Use the dates in these files as local origin dates and restrict to January and February 2025. Check for ties and report them, while selecting a deterministic route only if needed (alphabetical order). Return exact counts and rates to support synthesis.

Analyze the UA and WN carrier files for January and February 2025. For each carrier, group flights by undirected airport-pair route: alphabetically sort the two airport codes and join with '-'. (a) Find the route with the most scheduled flight records, including cancelled flights. (b) Consider only routes with at least 20 completed flights (cancelled=false and actual_dep present); compute departure delay as actual_dep minus sched_dep in minutes, treating an actual departure after midnight as the next day when necessary. A flight is delayed iff delay is more than 15 minutes. Find the route with the largest delayed/completed percentage. Restrict to Jan-Feb 2025 using the local dates in these files. Check and report ties and provide numerator, denominator, rate (one decimal percent), and scheduled count for the selected routes.

Analyze B6 and AS for January and February 2025. For B6, dates/times are local origin times. AS is special: date_utc, sched_dep_utc, and actual_dep_utc are UTC; convert each timestamp to local time at the origin using airports.csv utc_offset_hours before filtering to local January-February 2025 and before computing delay. (For AS, local date is UTC date plus the origin offset; actual departure may cross midnight as well.) For each carrier, make routes undirected by alphabetically sorting origin and destination airport codes and joining with '-'. (a) busiest means the largest count of scheduled records, including cancelled records. (b) worst means highest delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed (cancelled=false) flights; delayed means departure delay >15 minutes, with elapsed-minute handling across midnight. Exclude cancelled flights from both numerator and denominator. Report ties, counts, and one-decimal rates; use an explicitly stated deterministic alphabetical choice if exact ties exist. Validate airport offsets from airports.csv.

If a worker reports an exact tie, apply a consistent alphabetical choice for the single required route value and use the reported tie evidence to resolve any ambiguity. Return only the required carrier-to-busiest/worst mapping in the answer field, with a short rationale noting the counting and delay-rate rules.

for carrier in ['DL','AA']:

 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['comp']=(d.cancelled==False)&d.actual_dep.notna()
 def mins(x): return int(x[:2])*60+int(x[3:]) if pd.notna(x) else np.nan
 d['s']=d.sched_dep.map(mins); d['a']=d.actual_dep.map(mins); d['raw']=d.a-d.s; d['mod']=d.raw%1440
 print('\n',carrier,'rows',len(d),'cancel',(~d.comp).sum())
 print('raw negative completed',d.loc[d.comp & (d.raw<0),['route','sched_dep','actual_dep','raw','mod']].to_string(index=False))

import pandas as pd
from datetime import timedelta
ap=pd.read_csv('airports.csv'); print(ap.to_string(index=False))
B=pd.read_csv('airlines/B6.csv'); A=pd.read_csv('airlines/AS.csv')
# offsets validation uniqueness
print('offset dup?',ap.airport.duplicated().any(), 'origins B',set(B.origin)-set(ap.airport),'A',set(A.origin)-set(ap.airport))
# B route/filter
B['date']=pd.to_datetime(B.date)
B=B[B.date.dt.month.isin([1,2])].copy()
B['route']=B.apply(lambda x:'-'.join(sorted([x.origin,x.dest])),axis=1)
B['sched_dt']=pd.to_datetime(B.date.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+B.sched_dep)
B['actual_dt']=pd.to_datetime(B.date.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')+' '+B.actual_dep)
# elapsed handling across midnight
B.loc[B.actual_dt<B.sched_dt,'actual_dt']+=pd.Timedelta(days=1)
B['delay']=(B.actual_dt-B.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
# AS convert utc + origin offsets
A['dateutc']=pd.to_datetime(A.date_utc)
off=ap.set_index('airport').utc_offset_hours
A['offset']=A.origin.map(off)
A['sched_utc_dt']=pd.to_datetime(A.date_utc+' '+A.sched_dep_utc)
A['actual_utc_dt']=pd.to_datetime(A.date_utc+' '+A.actual_dep_utc)
A['sched_dt']=A.sched_utc_dt+pd.to_timedelta(A.offset,unit='h'); A['actual_dt']=A.actual_utc_dt+pd.to_timedelta(A.offset,unit='h')
A=A[(A.sched_dt.dt.month.isin([1,2]))].copy() # local Jan-Feb; wording filtering local; scheduled local date. likely date local from each timestamp. records date based sched departure.
A['route']=A.apply(lambda x:'-'.join(sorted([x.origin,x.dest])),axis=1)
A['delay']=(A.actual_dt-A.sched_dt).dt.total_seconds()/60
for name,D in [('B6',B),('AS',A)]:
 print('\n',name,len(D),D.sched_dt.min(),D.sched_dt.max())
 print('scheduled',D.route.value_counts().sort_index().to_dict())
 comp=D[D.cancelled==False]
 g=comp.groupby('route').agg(completed=('cancelled','size'),delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed*100
 print(g.sort_index().to_string())
 eligible=g[g.completed>=20]; mx=eligible.rate.max(); print('max',mx,eligible[eligible.rate==mx])
 print('cancel',D.cancelled.value_counts())
